candidate_identity.display_label: axis-isolated intervention search + freeze-before-outer-holdout decision audit

audit_subject.paper: Auto Research for Materials: Auditable AI-Scientist Workflows with Held-Out Transfer

grade.pairwise_89_3_raw_reconstruction_this_in: B-/not fully reconstructed from raw matrix

published_claim_scope.search_design: Seven axis-isolated campaigns across ten Matbench endpoints use only inner five-fold feedback for adaptive search; frozen interventions are then evaluated once on an outer fold-0 holdout that the agent process does not see.
published_claim_scope.primary_result: Nine of ten inner-selected single interventions remain the best tested single intervention on the outer holdout.
published_claim_scope.ordering_result: The paper reports 40 composition pairwise comparisons and 36 structure comparisons: 67 agree, 8 reverse, 1 tie, hence 67/(67+8)=89.333...% agreement among non-ties.
published_claim_scope.regret_result: Nine tasks have zero regret and jdft2d has 2.279 percentage points, giving 2.279/10 = 0.2279 percentage points mean regret.
published_claim_scope.blocked_null: The paper reports 5! x 4! = 2880 shared relabelings and 4 mappings with at least nine outer winners, giving 4/2880 = 0.0013888889.
published_claim_scope.scope_guard: This is evidence for held-out transfer of executable interventions in the tested materials-ML setup. It is not a matched ablation proving that the full protocol improves open-ended scientific truthfulness in general, nor does it establish source/study/batch-disjoint validation beyond the tested Matbench fold construction.

released: Complete retained trial table for all 701 evaluated changes across seven campaigns.
Seven frozen winner records and selected source snapshots.
Full-precision composition/structure/fusion certification JSON used by the paper verifier.
Structured LLM input/output records for all 514 completed SDK sessions, with rendered inputs, timestamped actions, model/token metadata and evaluated outcomes.
A MANIFEST.sha256 plus a standard-library verifier that checks every listed released byte.
A standard-library verify_claims.py script that reconstructs 4/4 composition, 5/6 structure, 9/10 total, four composition holdout effects, structure-axis means and the feature-plus-model assembly.

Pinned Python 3.12-era evaluation dependencies in paper_artifact/environment/requirements.lock, including exact versions for catboost, lightgbm, matbench, matminer, numpy, pandas, pymatgen, scikit-learn, scipy, spglib and xgboost.
Public holdout_certify.py, frontier_probe.py and bridge_eval.py evaluation entry points plus selected-code snapshots.
remaining_replay_dependencies: Matbench benchmark data are fetched from the upstream package and are not redistributed in the artifact.

Exact regeneration of the 701 search proposals depends on the historical commercial DeepSeek-V4-Pro service behavior rather than an immutable model snapshot; the released logs make consequential actions auditable without re-invoking it, but not generatively replayable byte-for-byte.
No GitHub release/DOI-backed repository snapshot was observed in this audit; current artifact bytes are still commit-addressable by the observed repository head.

independent_checks.claim_verifier_scope_inspection: Inspected the released verify_claims.py. It directly recomputes the 4/4 composition, 5/6 structure and 9/10 total winner-transfer claims from released certification JSON, plus selected effect/axis/fusion means.
independent_checks.campaign_count_check: Released campaign_summary.json records 100 retained evaluated trials for six campaigns and 101 for composition_representation, totaling 701; the extra completion is explicitly reported not to change the selected snapshot.
independent_checks.pairwise_gap: The fast released verify_claims.py does not recompute the 67/8/1 pairwise ordering counts, the 0.228 regret summary, the blocked-null enumeration, or median task-wise Spearman. The paper defines these statistics and the released certification matrices appear sufficient to recompute them, but this invocation did not independently parse the full raw matrices into a new 67/8/1 count. Therefore the specific 89.3% ordering statistic is not promoted to independently reconstructed evidence by this audit.
independent_checks.known_replay_disclosure: The public study archive/paper data-availability text discloses a jdft2d structure-model replay discrepancy caused by calibration state not restored in a separate process. The archive states that this changes that replay score but does not alter the primary selected Feature intervention or the 9/10 count. Treat this as a disclosed implementation/replay defect, not as evidence that the primary held-out selection result is false.

independent_replication_search.search_summary: Fresh searches located the paper, official repository, mirrors/indexes and summaries, but no third-party protocol-matched rerun reproducing the 701-attempt search plus once-only outer certification or the 9/10 and 89.3% headline statistics.
independent_replication_search.interpretation: Absence in this search is not proof that no independent rerun exists.

o_specific_adaptation.note: The candidate is used as external evidence for separating adaptive search feedback from frozen outer decision evidence. No O-specific validation gate, source-lineage split, or promotion policy was tested here.

supported: Freeze the exact executable intervention before revealing final evidence.
Audit the decision/intervention itself against all relevant alternatives, rather than treating a terminal pipeline score as attribution evidence.
Keep official benchmark replay separate from independent outer evidence when benchmark folds reuse adaptive-search examples.
Persist complete search chronology, frozen source identity and a byte manifest so post-hoc claim verification does not depend on re-invoking the commercial agent.
not_supported: A general claim that axis isolation plus one holdout prevents all adaptive overfitting in open-ended science.
A claim that 89.3% ordering agreement has been independently reproduced by this audit from the released raw matrices.
A claim that same-example Matbench fold isolation is equivalent to source/study/batch-lineage-disjoint scientific validation.
An O-specific mandatory promotion gate without separate matched tests.

reopen_conditions: A protocol-matched independent rerun reproduces or contradicts the 9/10 outer-selection and 67/8/1 pairwise-ordering results.
A public verifier is added that mechanically reconstructs pairwise ordering, selection regret and blocked-null statistics from the released raw matrices.
A DOI/release snapshot or immutable dataset/container bundle materially improves full model-evaluation replay.
The disclosed jdft2d replay discrepancy is corrected in a way that changes primary outer-selection or ordering results.
A matched autonomous-science experiment isolates axis-isolation/freeze-before-holdout against a terminal-score-only or otherwise weaker protocol under the same agent, tools and budget.
exact_next_action: Do not repeat unchanged candidate_053. On the next bootstrap-valid invocation, resolve the then-current exact sealed wave and audit a different source-qualified non-evaluation candidate with materially reducible reproduction uncertainty; reopen this lineage only on a recorded condition above.
